prompt: Cutoff opened first and hero is on the button with QJs. Which compact preflop action fits this transfer spot?
why_v1: The hand is playable and hero has position, but the open in front changes the action from first-in raise to call.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. QJs can continue in position after the cutoff opens, and calling respects the facing-open frame.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. Once the cutoff opens first, QJs on the button is a playable in-position continue, but the compact action is call instead of a first-in raise.
